WITH source_counts AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS spatial_survey_count
  FROM scanspatial AS ss
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(spatial_survey_count) AS total_count,
         AVG(spatial_survey_count) AS average_count
  FROM source_counts
)
SELECT sc.fundflux AS source,
       sc.spatial_survey_count AS count,
       1.0 * sc.spatial_survey_count / t.total_count AS share_of_total,
       sc.spatial_survey_count - t.average_count AS above_average
FROM source_counts AS sc
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
WHERE sc.spatial_survey_count > t.average_count;
